title: Controlling the Humanoid Robot H1-2 With a Simulated Biologically Plausible Network
title_zh: 用仿真的生物合理脉冲神经网络控制 H1-2 人形机器人
abstract_en: Artificial Spiking Neural Networks have gained remarkable attention in the last few years due to their proven ability in simulating biological neural cultures and producing similar activity and trends. Nevertheless, whether they can be trained for humanoid locomotion while retaining biological plausibility and robust performance at once remains an open question. We study this problem by proposing a biologically inspired spiking network, trained by different learning schemes and tested on the H1-2 Unitree Humanoid. These schemes differ in how recurrent weights are trained. Ordered from most to least biologically faithful, they are: a fixed reservoir mimicking an in-vitro neural culture, where recurrent weights are kept frozen and only a linear readout is trained, the same network but with its synapses trained by reward-modulated spike timing dependent plasticity and eligibility propagation, and finally backpropagation through time as a non biological baseline for comparison. All schemes relied on distillation of a reinforcement learning expert policy with dataset aggregation. We show that e-prop reached 100% survival rate matching backpropagation through time, whereas both the fixed reservoir and the reward-modulated STDP, though the closest to biological cultures, plateaued at a much lower performance (~43.7% and ~11% survival). We explore in further detail which trends a real culture could and could not produce until now. Finally we demonstrate brief bipedal stepping on a full size humanoid H1-2.
abstract_zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）能够复现体外培养神经网络的部分活动模式，但能否兼顾生物合理性与人形机器人步行控制的鲁棒性，仍是一个开放问题。本文在 Unitree H1-2 上比较了四种训练方案：冻结循环权重、只训练线性读出层的固定储备池（fixed reservoir）；使用奖励调制的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（reward-modulated STDP）或资格迹传播（e-prop）训练循环突触；以及作为非生物基线的时间反向传播（BPTT）。所有方案均通过数据集聚合蒸馏强化学习专家策略。评估中，e-prop 的存活率达到 100%，与 BPTT 持平；更贴近体外培养神经网络的固定储备池和 reward-modulated STDP 分别约为 43.7% 和 11%。论文还讨论了真实神经培养物有望复现哪些活动模式及其局限，并在全尺寸 H1-2 实机上展示了短暂的双足迈步。
key_points_zh: 四种方案共享强化学习专家策略与数据集聚合流程，主要区别在于是否以及如何训练循环权重。
e-prop 在评估中达到 100% 存活率，表明在该任务中，更具生物合理性的学习规则可以匹配 BPTT 基线。
固定储备池和 reward-modulated STDP 的存活率分别约为 43.7% 和 11%，说明更贴近神经培养物的方案并不一定带来更稳健的控制。
实机结果是全尺寸 Unitree H1-2 的短暂双足迈步；100% 存活率不应解读为已验证实机可长时间稳定行走。
